name: Ice Age
overview: Scripture reveals the natural phenomena of cold, frost, ice, and snow as part of God's sovereign creation and sustaining power. The Bible acknowledges the cyclical nature of seasons and weather patterns established by God, including cold and heat (Genesis 8:22). Job's poetic reflections emphasize that ice and frost come by the breath of God and are part of His control over creation's mysteries (Job 37:10; 38:29). These verses underscore that the ice age and cold climates are not random but are divinely ordained elements within the order of the natural world.
